Based on the provided image of the "Operate" mode for the flash-separation teaching app, here are the answers to your questions:

**(1) Sliders and Chiller Temperature:**
*   **Yes**, the right panel shows the first two of the four sliders mentioned: **Chiller temperature** and **Feed pressure**. (The other two sliders, "Ammonia in feed" and "Feed flow," are likely located further down the scrollable panel).
*   The **Chiller temperature** is set to **-20 °C**.

**(2) KPI Scorecard Section:**
*   **No**, there is no KPI scorecard section visible in the current view of the right panel. The area below the "Feed pressure" slider is occupied by descriptive text explaining the effect of pressure.

**(3) Layout Problems:**
*   **No significant layout problems** are visible. The text is clear, the sliders are fully rendered with their labels and value ranges, and the elements appear properly aligned within their respective containers.
